eye-chart-toolkit.当某行视标在检查距离 D（米）处所对视角为 5 弧分时，对应最佳矫正视力 1.0: When a row's optotype subtends 5 arc-min at the testing distance D (m), it corresponds to best-corrected acuity 1.0 (6/6 or 20/20). The letter height H = D × tan(5′) ÷ decimal acuity v, with tan(5′) ≈ 0.0014544 — e.g. the 6/6 row at 6 m is about 8.7 mm tall. The tool converts mm to px from your screen PPI, then applies display scaling; scaling only changes on-screen appearance, while the labeled mm are always the true physical size. Enter an accurate PPI and set display zoom to 100% to get optotypes matching a real chart.
eye-chart-toolkit.本次可识别最小行，如 6/6 或 20/20（留空取最底行）: Smallest row you can read, e.g. 6/6 or 20/20 (leave blank for bottom row)
eye-chart-toolkit.记录的是「恰好能辨认的最小行」: Record the smallest row you can just identify
eye-chart-toolkit.本工具为教学、自查与科普演示用途，所有视标按几何公式在浏览器本地绘制，，也不能替: This tool is for teaching, self-check and education. All optotypes are drawn locally by geometric formulas and cannot replace professional eye exams (standard logMAR chart, ETDRS chart, phoropter). Screen PPI and viewing distance carry error, and near testing is affected by accommodation, so results are for fun and initial reference only. If you suspect a vision problem, get a professional refraction.

vision-screening-21.每只眼独立计分：S = Σ(症状频率 0–4 × 该症状权重) ÷ (Σ权重 ×: Each eye is scored independently: S = Σ(symptom frequency 0–4 × symptom weight) ÷ (Σ weights × 4), giving a 0–1 "symptom load ratio" r. Approximate myopic equivalent-sphere amplitude D = 8.0 × r^1.25 × age factor (child 1.15 / teen 1.10 / adult 1.00 / senior 0.85), with ±(0.6 + (1−r^1.25)×1.2) D as the uncertainty band. Astigmatism is flagged when its related symptoms exceed a threshold, giving an axis-direction word (with-the-rule / against-the-rule / oblique). This is a questionnaire-based statistical approximation.
vision-screening-21.说明：问题会——若早期信号偏弱，会优先追问高权重的远距离症状；若出现散光迹象，会: Note: questions adapt — if early signals are weak, high-weight distance symptoms are asked first; if astigmatism signs appear, astigmatism items are brought forward. The whole flow is 21 questions, answered per eye.

amsler-grid-test.标准 Amsler 方格为 10×10cm 等比网格（每格约 5mm），中心设一: A standard Amsler grid is a 10×10 cm equidistant grid (each cell ~5 mm) with a central red dot, used at home to monitor macular function. Wear your usual correction, sit ~30 cm away in good light, test one eye at a time, and mark any waviness, breaks or dark areas directly on the grid.
amsler-grid-test.用手掌或眼罩遮住右眼，左眼注视中心红点，余光扫视四周方格。: Cover your right eye with your palm or patch; left eye fixes on the central red dot while your peripheral vision scans the surrounding squares.
amsler-grid-test.把左眼看到的任何扭曲、断裂、变大/变小或发暗区域画在网格上。: Mark any distortion, breaks, enlargement/shrinkage or darkening seen by the left eye on the grid.
amsler-grid-test.换遮左眼，用右眼重复第 1、2 步，分别记录。: Switch to cover the left eye and repeat steps 1–2 with the right eye, recording separately.
amsler-grid-test.保存本次快照，与历史快照并排对比，发现变化及时就医。: Save this snapshot and compare it side-by-side with history; seek care if you notice change.
amsler-grid-test.提示：点击「画区域」后在网格上依次落点勾出异常范围，双击或点「完成」闭合；「标点: Tip: click "Draw area", then drop points along the abnormal region; double-click or click "Done" to close it. "Mark point" is for scattered dark spots.
amsler-grid-test.快照仅保存在你本机浏览器中，不会上传任何服务器。可任选两张做并排对比，观察黄斑区: Snapshots are stored only in your local browser and never uploaded. Pick any two for a side-by-side comparison to watch macular changes over time.
amsler-grid-test.暂无快照，测完一眼镜格后点击「保存本次快照」。: No snapshot yet — finish one eye then click "Save this snapshot".
amsler-grid-test.本 Amsler 方格表仅用于黄斑功能的居家自我监测与科普，。它无法发现青光眼、: This Amsler grid is for home self-monitoring and education of macular function only. It cannot detect glaucoma, early retinal detachment, peripheral lesions and many other eye diseases. If you notice new waviness, bent lines, a central scotoma, or metamorphopsia (things look larger/smaller), or the two eyes disagree, see an ophthalmologist promptly — don't delay because self-test was "normal". Those with diabetes, hypertension or a family history of macular degeneration should get regular OCT and fundus exams.

astigmatism-chart.标准散光放射线表（又称“太阳表/钟表盘”）由中心向外发射等角度射线组成。规则散光: A standard astigmatic fan chart (also called a "sunburst / clock dial") emits equally spaced rays from the center. In regular astigmatism the cornea curves differently by direction, so some rays look blurrier, fainter or vanish. Wear your usual correction, sit ~30–40 cm away in good light, test one eye at a time, and mark the sectors you find blurry.
astigmatism-chart.遮住右眼，左眼从中心红点向外逐条比较射线清晰度。: Cover the right eye; left eye compares ray clarity outward from the center dot, one by one.
astigmatism-chart.点击所有看起来更模糊/更淡的射线（可多选）。: Click every ray that looks blurrier/fainter (multiple allowed).
astigmatism-chart.换遮左眼，用右眼重复第 1、2 步。: Switch to cover the left eye and repeat steps 1–2 with the right eye.
astigmatism-chart.系统依据模糊扇区估算散光大致轴位与相对严重度。: The system estimates the approximate astigmatic axis and relative severity from the blurred sectors.
astigmatism-chart.操作：用鼠标或手指单击某条射线即可标记/取消“模糊”。系统会高亮该扇区并实时估算: Operation: click a ray with mouse or finger to mark/unmark "blurry". The system highlights the sector and estimates the axis in real time.
astigmatism-chart.尚未标记。请先按步骤遮盖一眼，再点击看起来更模糊的射线。: Not marked yet. Cover one eye per the steps, then click the rays that look blurrier.
astigmatism-chart.记录仅保存在本机浏览器，不上传任何服务器，可随时回看与对比。: Records stay in your local browser only, never uploaded — review and compare anytime.
astigmatism-chart.暂无记录，测完整双眼后点击「保存记录」。: No records yet — after testing both eyes, click "Save record".
astigmatism-chart.本放射线自测表仅用于散光风险的，。它给出的“轴位/严重度”是依据你主观清晰度判断: This fan chart only screens astigmatism risk. Its "axis/severity" is a rough estimate from your subjective clarity judgment, with large error, and cannot distinguish regular astigmatism, irregular astigmatism or keratoconus. If you suspect astigmatism, vision loss, eye strain, night glare, or uneven clarity between eyes, get a subjective refraction, corneal topography and fundus exam. Minors and those with unstable refraction should be rechecked regularly.
